name: Aurora Silk Waterfall
description: A waterfall of flowing silk fabric dyed in aurora colors, cascading over a cliff into a pool of liquid light.
prompt: A cliffside where a waterfall is not water but cascading silk ribbons — emerald, magenta, sapphire — moving fluidly. At the base, a pool glows with the same hues. Soft motion blur, luminous fabric texture, 8K.
caption: Silk that falls like the northern lights. 🌈🌊 #AuroraSilkWaterfall
